nodes.summary: `gaussianMatrixLaw n ℓ` is the law of an $n \times \ell$ standard Gaussian matrix: independent $N(0,1)$ entries, as a product measure on the entry functions $\{0,\dots,n-1\} \times \{0,\dots,\ell-1\} \to \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Standard Gaussian test matrix

nodes.summary: Under the hypotheses of the Frobenius bound (real $m \times n$ matrix $A$, $k \ge 2$, $p \ge 2$, $k + p \le \min\{m,n\}$, $\Omega$ an $n \times (k+p)$ standard Gaussian matrix, $Y = A\Omega$), where $\|\cdot\|$ is the spectral norm. nodes.title: Average spectral error of the randomized range finder

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a real $m \times n$ matrix with singular values $\sigma_1 \ge \sigma_2 \ge \cdots$. Choose a target rank $k \ge 2$ and an oversampling parameter $p \ge 2$ with $k + p \le \min\{m, n\}$. Let $\Omega$ be an $n \times (k+p)$ standard Gaussian matrix and $Y = A\Omega$. nodes.title: Average Frobenius error of the randomized range finder

nodes.summary: `residualFrobenius A Ω` is the Frobenius norm $\|(I - P_Y)A\|_F = \big(\sum_j \|(I - P_Y)A e_j\|^2\big)^{1/2}$ of the range-finder residual, where $e_j$ are the standard basis vectors of $\mathbb{R}^n$.
nodes.title: Frobenius error of the range finder

nodes.summary: For a real $m \times n$ matrix $A$ and a test matrix $\Omega \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times \ell}$, let $P_Y$ be the orthogonal projection of $\mathbb{R}^m$ onto the range of the sample matrix $Y = A\Omega$. `residual A Ω` is the operator $(I - P_Y)A : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^m$, whose norm is the error of the approximation $A \approx P_Y A = Q Q^* A$ with $Q$ an orthonormal basis of $\operatorname{range}(Y)$.
nodes.title: Range-finder residual

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
